lines.text: A man of God from Judah cries out against the altar at Bethel and says it will be split apart.
Jeroboam stretches out his hand and says "Seize him!", but it withers until the man of God prays.
The man of God refuses the king's reward and leaves Bethel by the same road he came on.

wrong_details.wrong: the same road he came on

lines.text: The old prophet finds the man of God under a juniper tree, lies about an angel, and he goes back and eats.
A lion kills the man of God on the road, and the old prophet lays his body in his own tomb.
